strategies.name: RELIANCE 15m: trend wake-up (choppiness drop, low MFI, volume surge)
strategies.description: Choppiness(14) falls > 5 in 3 candles, MFI(14) < 53, volume slope jumps; +2% target / -1% stop, held overnight, max 3 days (75 candles). 2026 RELIANCE 15m: 43 trades, win 49%, avg +0.44%, PF 1.77 (pattern_check 2026-11-22). Worked on only ~18% of 200 other stocks - RELIANCE-specific.
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (chop(14) - chop(14)[3] < -5 and mfi(14) < 53 and (slope(volume, 5) - slope(volume, 5)[3]) / max(sma(volume, 20), 1) >= 0.6)
